quests.title: Wet Coal
quests.summary: The Upper hearths' charcoal sells at half in the city, called wet. Follow it down and find out why.

offer.say: #greet#, #address#. It sells. At half. The city store says our sacks come in wet. They leave here dry, I'd stake the hearth on it. Ask our carter what they paid, look over the east floor by daylight, ask the young collier what she found at dawn, then go down and see the store yourself.
offer.accept: I'll find out where the dry sacks go.
offer.handIn: Your char is sold twice and dried once.
offer.thanks: #thanks#. Wetted at night, dried by somebody else, sold at the yard door for half. A riddle with a band of thieves at the bottom of it. Find their fire. It won't be far from water.

objectives.label: Ask the carter what the city store paid.
Look over the east burning floor by daylight.
Ask the young collier what she found at dawn.
Go down to the Timberland Charcoal Store in Ridgemere.
Ask the store hand where his cheap sacks come from.

rewards.detail: followed the Upper hearths' charcoal down to the city

quests.title: The Fire Below the Tarn
quests.summary: Find where the stolen char is dried, below Kestrel Tarn, break the thieves and take back a marked sack.

objectives.label: Ask the collier who counts everything how much waste went missing.
Ask the lime burner what passed on the quarry road.
Find the thieves' drying fire below Kestrel Tarn after dark.
Take back a sack with the Upper hearths' mark on it.

quests.title: A Price by the Sack
quests.summary: Win the Upper hearths a price by the sack from the city store.

objectives.label: Tell the collier: sell to the city store, at a price by the sack.
Give the store hand two sacks of charcoal, to show him what dry looks like.
Tell the carter she drives on Marketday.

rewards.detail: won the Upper hearths a price by the sack in the city

quests.title: Frosthollow Burns Its Own
quests.summary: Help Frosthollow sell its own charcoal on its own square.

objectives.label: Tell the collier: sell it here, on our own square.
Give the collier two sacks of charcoal for the stall.
Stand the Frosthollow square with the colliers on a Marketday.

rewards.detail: sold Frosthollow's charcoal on its own square
